status: Open research/concept holds; no operation/fabrication approval

holds.required_evidence: Actual belt reinforcement/splices, frames, return run, rollers, fasteners and drive/actuator EMI must be characterized. Exclusion-box extent is provisional.
Map mounted empty-belt/reference responses over X/Y/Z, poses, frequencies and feed; 180 mm lane is not measured sensor coverage.

Six functional windings have continuous illustrative three-pass paths, insulation, separate terminals and recessed return channels. Select electrical turns/wire/insulation, frequency/current, polarity, Rx combination, parasitics, bandwidth, thermal design, retention/manufacture and calibration. Internal harness from terminal pairs to cartridge cable exits, shielding, pinout, synchronous drive/phase reference and channel delays remain unresolved. No complete electrical circuit or balanced response is established.
Compare pose/geometry-conditioned directional and frequency sequences against strong simpler baselines on held-out objects/lots. No multi-angle advantage demonstrated.

Host must meter into central lane before stationary exclusion masks. Size/height/mass/occupancy, jam/escape/collision, skirts, wear and contamination require tests; no operating feed envelope approved.

Select materials/fasteners, loads, vibration, deflection, wear, manufacturability, retention and tolerances. Nominal contacts and gaps are not load certification. Real socket recesses do not complete simplified receiver passages, bearing surfaces, fastener engagement or installation design.

inherited_receiver_interfaces.window_bridge_bolt_*: Window bridge/post receiver passages and bearing faces require coordinated drilling or retained-insert design; several current shafts overlap receiver material.
inherited_receiver_interfaces.mount_bolt_*: Four nominal clamp shafts cross lower-side-rail receiver material; rail pass-through details require coordinated source edits before installation.
inherited_receiver_interfaces.lane_retainer_*: Guide/drop/arm receivers are simplified engagement geometry; clearance, insert, bearing and retention details unresolved.
inherited_receiver_interfaces.under_cover_retainer_*: Cover receiver geometry, captive retention, passage and sealing remain unqualified.
inherited_receiver_interfaces.control_panel_retainer_*: Panel and enclosure receiver passages/retained inserts remain unresolved.
inherited_receiver_interfaces.rgb_mount_screw_*: Small nominal shaft/housing interference is illustrative engagement only; no helical thread, material, preload or strength selected.

holds.required_evidence: Nominal Y/Z slots and under-head spacer adjustment shown; complete movement, retention, repeatability, standards, target placement and safe calibration procedures unvalidated.
Register the same moving fragment across separated optical/A/B stations under slip, roll, bounce, stops and ramps. Encoder measures belt travel only.
Measured excitation/settling/demodulation, common timebase, channel delay and processing-tail latency required. Last required usable observation X and usable downstream distance TBD.
Module only proposes object decision output. Downstream transport/scheduling/ejection and physical capture need independent integration tests and ownership.
RGB / optional 3D device, lens/FOV across height, illumination, contamination windows and calibration unselected. Centreline clearance is not FOV validation.

Power, pinouts/protocol, protection, grounding, EMC, thermal, ingress, guards/interlocks/isolation/restart require competent installation-specific design. Classification confidence is not a certified safety function.
New array/channel layout, fields, crosstalk, calibration, timing and mechanics required; no 600 mm sensing coverage claim.
Grey segment omits roller bearings, drive, belt turnaround curves and complete guards. It is an interface illustration, not a host design or structural approval.

Wall bores, gland bearing faces and separated external source paths are modeled. Select actual cables, minimum bend radii, strain relief, shielding/grounding, remaining tray/clips and service disconnection. Only the four overhead optical saddles are modeled as local supports. Encoder sensor-end seal and all internal harnesses/pinouts remain unresolved.
